- packaging.ranges.VersionRange.intersection(other) [method]: Range containing exactly the versions in both self and other.

Both operands must share the same configured pre-release policy;
otherwise :exc:`ValueError` is raised.

>>> a = SpecifierSet(">=1.0").to_range()
>>> b = SpecifierSet("<2.0").to_range()
>>> a.intersection(b) == SpecifierSet(">=1.0,<2.0").to_range()
True
- packaging.specifiers.SpecifierSet.to_range() [method]: Return the :class:`~packaging.ranges.VersionRange` this set accepts.

An empty set yields the full range; an unsatisfiable set yields the
empty range. ``===`` specifiers contribute literal-string admission.

>>> SpecifierSet(">=1.0,<2.0").to_range()
<VersionRange '[1.0, 2.0.dev0)'>

.. versionadded:: 26.3

- packaging.tags.mac_platforms(version, arch) [function]: Yields the :attr:`~Tag.platform` tags for macOS.

The `version` parameter is a two-item tuple specifying the macOS version to
generate platform tags for. The `arch` parameter is the CPU architecture to
generate platform tags for. Both parameters default to the appropriate value
for the current system.

:param tuple version: A two-item tuple representing the version of macOS.

- packaging.tags.interpreter_name() [function]: Returns the name of the running interpreter.

Some implementations have a reserved, two-letter abbreviation which will
be returned when appropriate.

This typically acts as the prefix to the :attr:`~Tag.interpreter` tag.

.. versionadded:: 20.0

- packaging.tags.interpreter_version(warn) [function]: Returns the running interpreter's version.

This typically acts as the suffix to the :attr:`~Tag.interpreter` tag.

:param bool warn: Whether warnings should be logged. Defaults to ``False``.

.. versionadded:: 20.0

- packaging.tags.compatible_tags(python_version, interpreter, platforms) [function]: Yields the tags for an interpreter compatible with the Python version
specified by ``python_version``.

The specific tags generated are:

- ``py*-none-<platform>``
- ``<interpreter>-none-any`` if ``interpreter`` is provided
- ``py*-none-any``

- packaging.tags.interpreter_abi() [function]: Returns the running interpreter's ABI tag.

This typically acts as the :attr:`~Tag.abi` tag of the most specific tag

- packaging.tags.platform_tags() [function]: Yields the :attr:`~Tag.platform` tags for the running interpreter.
